newsitem.title: GERMANY: Baden-Wuerttemberg Nov CPI up 1.3 pct year-on-year.
newsitem.headline: Baden-Wuerttemberg Nov CPI up 1.3 pct year-on-year.

text.p: The statistics office of the German state of Baden-Wuerttemberg said on Friday November consumer prices were down 0.1 percent on the previous month and up 1.3 percent year-on-year.
In October the monthly figure was unchanged on the previous month and prices year-on-year were up 1.3 percent.
The data was the first of four figures from the German states which are used to calculate preliminary German inflation.
